title: Camic Electric Stand Mixer,7.45 QT,10 Speeds with Dough Hook,Whisk, Flat Beater Attachments, Splash Guard, Easy-Carry Top Handle,3-IN-1 Kitchen Mixer for Baking Cakes Cookie Bread Salad (Black)
reviews: Not as sturdy as my old mix master.

I have been through a few different mixers over the years and many of them tend to get hot or start smelling like smoke when I try to make thick dough. This model has a pure copper motor that seems to breathe much better. I have been using it of late for some heavy-duty tasks and it has not shown any signs of slowing down. The rugged ABS housing stays cool to the touch and the machine is very stable. I do not have to worry about it walking across my counter while it is working. The pulse function is also very snappy and responsive. I used it to fold some nuts into a heavy brownie batter and it worked like a charm. The digital timer setting is located right where I can see it, and it makes my prep work much more organized. I am also a big fan of the nesting design for the bowls. It is such a simple idea but it makes a huge difference for someone with a lot of stuff in their kitchen. The fact that everything is dishwasher-safe is just the icing on the cake. I have used the egg whisk for making breakfast and the dough hook for my lunch prep, and cleaning up both times was as simple as putting them in the machine. It is a very sturdy and reliable piece of equipment that feels like it belongs in a much higher price bracket. I am glad I decided to go with this one. It has all the features I need without being overly complicated. The attachments are easy to swap out and they lock in tight so there is no wobbling while the motor is running. It is exactly what I needed for my daily cooking.

Not for commercial use. This will mix light batters, frostings, and other thin recipes. It struggles with anything thicker and will wear out with repetitive use. A single batch of cookie dough is the limit. That being said, love the color options and size of the bowl. Especially love the suction cups for feet! I have to scrape the ingredients down much more often than a kitchen aid but for the price it’s worth it. For at home use only!

My cookies and cakes have never come out better than they did after I started using this electric food mixer. I just received it and the flat beater has already proven to be a vital tool for my baking. It creams butter and sugar together so smoothly that my cookies have this incredible melt-in-your-mouth texture. I used to do this with a hand mixer, but the 10 speeds on this machine give me so much more range. I can start at a very slow crawl and then ramp it up to a high-speed whip in seconds. The motor is a pure copper motor, which I know is a sign of quality for these kinds of appliances. It feels heavy and stable on the counter, and the rugged ABS housing gives me confidence that it will stay in good shape for years to come. I really like the digital timer setting because it takes the guesswork out of my recipes. When a set of instructions says to beat for three minutes, I can actually see the seconds ticking away. It makes my kitchen feel more like a professional bakery. The nesting design of the bowls is also a major plus. I can keep all the parts together so I never lose the smaller bowl in the back of my cupboard. The stainless steel whisk is also very high quality. I used it to make a meringue and the peaks were stiff and shiny in no time. It is such a versatile machine that I find myself looking for new things to make just so I can use it again.

I have been spending a lot more time in my kitchen lately and this 3-IN-1 Kitchen Mixer has been the center of everything I am doing. I just got it a bit ago and I have already put it through its paces with everything from light whipped cream to thick, sticky pizza dough. It has a lot of torque and can handle a heavy load without making a huge racket. I like that I can hear my music or talk to someone while it is running. The rugged ABS housing feels very thick and high-quality, not like some of those cheap plastic ones you see in the big box stores. The digital timer setting is a feature I did not think I would care about, but now I use it every single time. It helps me stay on track when I am following a complicated recipe that requires specific mixing intervals. The 10 speeds with the pulse function give me total control over the texture of my food. I can get a very coarse chop or a very fine blend depending on what I am aiming for. The nesting design is another favorite of mine because it keeps my kitchen looking neat and organized. Both of the stainless steel bowls are built to last and they are very easy to clean. Since they are dishwasher-safe, I do not have to spend my evening scrubbing away at the sink. The attachments, like the flat beater and the dough hook, have a special protection layer that keeps food from sticking to them, which is a huge help.

One of the things I hate most about baking is the mountain of dishes that usually follows a session, but this setup makes it much less of a chore. All of the tools that come with this 3-IN-1 Kitchen Mixer can go right into the dishwasher. I have used it of late for several different recipes and every time I am finished, I just pop the whisk or the hook into the rack and forget about it. There is no stuck-on dough that I have to scrub off by hand because of the protection layer they put on the attachments. The machine itself is quite powerful. I was surprised at how much it can handle given the compact look of the housing. I also love the nesting design because I can keep both bowls together without taking up two spots in my cabinet. It is a very clever way to organize a kitchen. When I was whipping up a salad dressing, the pulse function was very helpful for getting the oil and vinegar to emulsify without overdoing it. The motor is clearly built well because it does not struggle at all when I switch between speeds. I have not had it for very long, but it has already become my go-to tool for almost everything I do in the kitchen. It is nice to find a product that is reliable and does not require a lot of extra work to maintain.

We have been baking at home more lately because my daughter keeps asking to make cookies on weekends. My old hand mixer started struggling with thicker dough, so we switched to this stand mixer. The bowl size is bigger than I expected and helped when making double batches. My husband used the dough hook first for pizza dough, and the motor handled it without sounding strained. I mostly use the whisk attachment for cake batter and whipped cream. The different speed settings make it easier to start slow without flour flying everywhere. One thing I noticed right away was that the mixer stayed pretty steady on the counter while running. Cleanup has also been easier since the attachments go into the dishwasher. The splash guard helped a lot when adding dry ingredients because my kitchen usually ends up messy. It does take up some counter space, but we have been using it enough that it stays out most of the week now.
